blocks.text: Appliance Removal Services — Frequently Asked Questions

items.q: What types of appliances do you remove?
a: We remove all types of appliances, including refrigerators, stoves, dishwashers, washers, dryers, freezers, microwaves, and built-in units.

items.q: Do you offer same-day appliance removal?
a: Yes, we offer same-day removal when availability permits. Just call us for immediate service options.

items.q: Do you recycle or donate old appliances?
a: Yes, we recycle about 85% of materials and donate working appliances to local charities when possible.

items.q: How much does appliance removal cost?
a: Prices start at $125 per appliance, with final cost depending on size, type, and any special removal requirements.

items.q: Do I need to move the appliance outside before pickup?
a: No, we’ll remove appliances from wherever they’re located in your home or business.
